subject: Kickoff: DrJAX as our parallel-computation authoring layer
body:
Hi Jelena, Yusuf,

Kicking off DrJAX adoption for the efficiency portfolio. The library embeds a MapReduce programming model directly into JAX: a simple authoring surface for map/reduce computations, execution that leans on JAX's sharding machinery for datacenter-scale efficiency, and — the differentiator — full differentiability through the communication primitives themselves, broadcasts and reductions included. That last part is what our large-scale training teams keep hand-rolling badly.

Product goal: DrJAX becomes the sanctioned way to author these computations internally, replacing three divergent homegrown wrappers I know of.

Milestones: internal wheel + CI green by mid-April, two pilot teams migrated by end of May, adoption guide and readout by end of June, ahead of Q3 OKR lock on the 26th.

Jelena — staffing and platform asks to you.

Zofia
